title: Product Photography for Houston Brands
metaTitle: Product Photography for Houston Brands | TDM
metaDescription: Product photography for Houston brands and distributors: catalogue, lifestyle and detail shots taken in the US by TDM's team, retouched and ready to publish.
lead: TDM (The Digital Marketing Services) photographs products for Houston brands, online stores and distributors. We produce clean catalogue sets, styled lifestyle scenes and close detail shots, retouched and delivered in every crop your store, marketplace listings and ads need. Our team in the United States takes the photographs, on location or in a setting that suits the range, and retouching is done at our operations office in Lahore. We do not have a studio in Houston. You approve the shot list and art direction first and receive the finished images online.

sections.heading: Two kinds of Houston catalogue
paragraphs: Product photography here serves two quite different sellers. The first is the consumer brand: a hot sauce or barbecue rub maker, a coffee roaster, a candle or skincare label, a boot and western wear shop whose busiest weeks come around the rodeo. These sellers compete on appetite and style, and their images have to work on a phone screen in a feed as well as on a product page.

The second is the industrial supplier, and Houston has a great many of them. Distributors of fittings, gauges, hand tools, safety gear and instrumentation increasingly sell through online catalogues, and buyers compare parts by eye before they check a specification. A consistent set, with the same angle, lighting and background for every item and a clear close-up of markings and threads, makes a distributor look organised and reduces ordering mistakes.

sections.heading: What the service covers
paragraphs: We map your catalogue and sales channels first, then write a set list: which angles, scenes and details each product needs. For larger ranges we set up a repeatable lighting and framing system for each category, so hundreds of items read as one catalogue.
bullets: Catalogue photography on white or coloured backgrounds, lit consistently across the range.
Lifestyle scenes with props and surfaces chosen to suit your brand, for ads, social and hero banners.
Macro shots of materials, finishes, labels and mechanisms.
Image sets specified to Amazon and other marketplace requirements for background, framing and resolution.
Retouching that is colour-accurate and honest, because misleading images come back as returns.
Files exported in each crop and resolution required, named to your convention.

sections.heading: Preparing a Houston range for the camera
paragraphs: A shoot goes faster when the products are ready for it. Provide clean samples, and for packaged goods the current label version. Group items by category and tell us which part numbers or flavours need their own image. Our US-based team checks the condition of everything before the session, and we agree beforehand whether samples are returned or kept.

Compact, stable items such as bottles, jars, boxed goods, apparel, accessories, tools and small parts are the simplest to photograph in volume on one set. Other subjects have to be photographed where they are. Fresh dishes belong in the restaurant kitchen that plates them, and a large valve assembly or a skid-mounted unit is best photographed in the yard or shop where it stands, with the background cleaned up afterwards by our retouchers in Lahore.

sections.heading: Checks worth making with any photographer
paragraphs: Ask how many images per product are included and which angles. Ask whether retouching is included. Ask to see a test set of a few items before the full range is shot, so lighting and background are agreed early. And ask how new products will be matched to the existing set later.

faqs.q: Is there a TDM photo studio in Houston?
faqs.a: No, we have no studio in Houston. The photographs are taken in the United States by TDM's own team, on location or in a setting suited to the products. Houston clients approve the shot list and art direction in advance, and the images are retouched at our operations office in Lahore and delivered digitally.

faqs.q: How much does product photography cost for a Houston business?
faqs.a: It depends on the scope: the number of products, the images per product and how much styling is involved. We quote after a free consultation.

faqs.q: Can you photograph a large industrial parts catalogue?
faqs.a: Yes. We set up one lighting and framing system for each category so every item is consistent, then shoot and retouch in batches. Heavy or oversized equipment is photographed where it sits.

faqs.q: Can you photograph restaurant food or fresh products?
faqs.a: Yes. Fresh dishes are photographed on location, in the kitchen or dining room, because plated food does not wait. Packaged, shelf-stable food such as sauces, seasonings and coffee can be photographed on a set alongside the rest of a range.

faqs.q: How long will it take to get my images?
faqs.a: It depends on the brief and the size of the range, and on how many items need styling. The schedule is agreed in the plan before the session is booked.
